title: Galbi
subtitle: korean short ribs
excerpt: Galbi is beef short ribs marinated in soy sauce, garlic, and Asian pear then grilled until caramelised and sticky. The ribs are cut flanken-style across the bone for fast cooking. Serves 4.
sourceNotes: Galbi, meaning 'rib', is a cornerstone of Korean barbecue. The flanken cut and soy-based marinade developed over centuries of Korean grilling traditions.

recipe.freezeNotes: Freeze raw marinated ribs flat in sealed bags for up to 2 months. Thaw fully in the fridge before grilling.
recipe.batchNotes: Double the batch and freeze half before cooking.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Marinate overnight for the best flavour.

glossaryTerms.definition: A way of cutting short ribs across the bones rather than between them. Each piece contains several small cross-sections of bone and is thin enough to cook quickly over high heat.
A seasoned liquid mixture used to soak meat or vegetables before cooking. It flavours the food and, in some cases, helps tenderise it.

Ask your butcher for flanken-cut short ribs, also called LA-cut galbi. They should be around 1 cm thick. Thicker cuts need more cooking time.

items.prepNote: flanken-cut short ribs, about 1 cm thick

content.text: Rinse the ribs under cold water and pat dry. Soak in cold water for 30 minutes to draw out blood. Drain and pat dry again.
Mix all the marinade ingredients in a large bowl. Add the ribs and turn to coat each piece fully. Cover and refrigerate for at least 8 hours or overnight.
Remove the ribs from the fridge 30 minutes before cooking. Heat a griddle pan or cast iron skillet over very high heat until smoking.

Grill the ribs in batches for 2 to 3 minutes per side. The marinade contains sugar and will char quickly. This is desirable. Do not move the ribs too early or they will not release from the pan cleanly.
Rest for 5 minutes. Scatter sesame seeds and spring onion over the top. Serve with steamed rice and kimchi.

attrs.issue: Ribs are burning on the outside but raw near the bone
attrs.fix: The heat is too high or the ribs are too thick. Lower the heat slightly and cook for longer on each side.
Pat the ribs dry with kitchen paper before grilling. Excess liquid prevents caramelisation.
Flanken ribs need to marinate for at least 8 hours. A shorter marinade gives less tender results. Also make sure they are cooked through to the bone.

content.text: Galbi is part of the Korean barbecue tradition eaten at table grills. It is a more premium dish than samgyeopsal and often marks a celebration. It is also popular as takeaway and in lunch sets at Korean restaurants. The dish is found across Korea and in Korean communities worldwide.
